page.layout: One printed page, all lines centred. Title block from top to bottom, then a single printer's mark at the foot.
page.notes: The second line of the title reads "LITTERA-" with a printed hyphen, continued on the next line as "RVM BONONIÆ". The "P" of PATRVM and the "E" of Excellentia are large decorative initials. The word beginning the second-last line is worn; the scan shows a letter that could be "o" or "b", so I read it as "obiectiones" with [?]. The final word "untur:" is also worn and marked [?]. The small "R" at the foot is a printer's gathering mark, given as signature. No other text, stamps or show-through appear on the page.
